verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Mistral Document AI is an API product, but nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt file, markdown docs and official SDKs are related artifacts, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
